newsitem.title: USA: NYPA sees 800 MW nuke at full output over weekend.
newsitem.headline: NYPA sees 800 MW nuke at full output over weekend.

text.p: New York Power Authority's (NYPA) 800 megawatt (MW) Fitzpatrick nuclear power station in Scriba, N.Y., was expected to reach full output over the weekend, the state power agency said Friday.
"We're at 70 percent power...We're expected at full power some time this weekend," said company spokesman Tim Carroll.
The utility needed more time to repair a seal in one of the plant's feedwater pumps, he added.
Fitzpatrick was tripped off line Sept 16 when a technician caused an electrical short, which in turn opened the generator output breakers and automatically shut the reactor.
Indian Point 3, NYPA's other nuclear facility, was producing electricity at its full 980 MW capacity, according the Nuclear Regulatory Commisson's daily status report on Friday.
NYPA provides about a fourth of New York's electricity.
